title: Step 2 - Visualizing Random Forest Regression: Interpreting Stairs and Splits

cues.en: Instructor: And now we actually need to input a third argument.
cues.zh: 現在還要輸入第三個引數。

cues.en: Can you guess what that is?
cues.zh: 猜猜是什麼？

cues.en: For those of you who followed the Python tutorial, well, you will guess what it's gonna be.
cues.zh: 看過 Python 教學，應該猜得出來。

cues.en: It's actually going to be ntree, the number of trees in the forest.
cues.zh: 是 ntree，也就是森林的樹木數量。

cues.en: Well, of course we're building a random forest so it's actually a lot better if we can choose the number of trees that we build in our forest.
cues.zh: 建立隨機森林時，當然最好能自行選擇要建多少棵樹。

cues.en: And it's even better considering the fact that we're gonna play around with different number of trees.
cues.zh: 尤其我們還會嘗試不同數量。

cues.en: That is we're gonna start with 10 trees, with a forest of 10 trees.
cues.zh: 先從十棵樹的森林開始。

cues.en: And then we'll try with a lot more than 10 trees, like 100 trees or 300 trees, or 500 trees.
cues.zh: 再試更多，例如 100、300 或 500 棵。

cues.en: So that's why we're going to input the third argument ntree and we are gonna start with 10 trees.
cues.zh: 所以加入第三個引數 ntree，先設為 10。

cues.en: All right, so let's start with this.
cues.zh: 就從這裡開始。

cues.en: And that's all the arguments we need to build a random forest.
cues.zh: 這就是建立隨機森林所需的全部引數。

cues.en: We only need the independent variables, the dependent variable, and the number of trees.
cues.zh: 只需要自變數、應變數與樹的數量。

cues.en: And that will already make a robust random forest regression model.
cues.zh: 已能建立穩健的隨機森林迴歸模型。

cues.en: And then we will make it even more robust by adding more trees in the forest.
cues.zh: 之後再增加樹，提升穩健性。

cues.en: But before we continue, let's set the random factors to something fixed so that we all get the same results.
cues.zh: 不過繼續前，先固定隨機因素，讓大家結果一致。

cues.en: So in Python we use the random state parameter equal to zero.
cues.zh: Python 使用 random_state=0。

cues.en: Here we can do the same on R by using the set.seed function.
cues.zh: R 可以用 set.seed 做相同處理。

cues.en: And then in this function, we actually input a seed.
cues.zh: 在函數裡輸入種子。

cues.en: And we can use whatever seed we want.
cues.zh: 可使用任何種子。

cues.en: In Python we usually take zero or 42.
cues.zh: Python 通常選 0 或 42。

cues.en: And in R, what we like to do is to take either 1, 2, 3, or 1, 2, 3, 4.
So let's use this seed to all get the same result and that will make this tutorial easier to follow if you're coding at the same time.
cues.zh: 我們使用相同種子，讓同步撰寫的你更容易對照。

cues.en: So now we're all good.
cues.zh: 現在都準備好了。

cues.en: We're actually all good with the whole code.
cues.zh: 全部程式碼都沒問題。

cues.en: We don't have anything to replace.
cues.zh: 沒有其他內容需要修改。

cues.en: The only thing that we'll do now is to try several random forests with several number of trees and look at the visualization results and look at the prediction to see if we're getting close
cues.zh: 接下來只需嘗試不同樹數的隨機森林，查看圖形與預測，看看是否接近

cues.en: to the supposed 160K previous salary of our new employee that is about to be hired.
cues.zh: 準備雇用的員工聲稱的前薪資 160K。

cues.en: So let's do it.
cues.zh: 開始吧。

cues.en: Let's execute the sections one by one.
cues.zh: 逐段執行。

cues.en: So let's import a dataset first.
cues.zh: 先匯入資料集。

cues.en: Here we go, dataset well imported.
cues.zh: 資料集已成功匯入。

cues.en: We make sure we have our two columns, the independent variable level and the dependent variable salary.
cues.zh: 確認有兩欄，自變數 Level 與應變數 Salary。

cues.en: Perfect.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: Now no need to split the dataset into the training set and the test set.
cues.zh: 不分成訓練集與測試集。

cues.en: No need to apply feature scaling and now time to create our first random forest.
cues.zh: 也不用特徵縮放，現在建立第一個隨機森林。

cues.en: So let's do this.
cues.zh: 開始吧。

cues.en: Let's execute this code section here.
cues.zh: 執行這段程式。

cues.en: And here it is, random forest well created, perfect.
cues.zh: 隨機森林已成功建立，很好。

cues.en: So now it's time to have fun.
cues.zh: 現在開始有趣的部分。

cues.en: Would you like to visualize the result first or getting the prediction?
cues.zh: 想先視覺化，還是先取得預測？

cues.en: Well first, let's maybe visualize the results because we wanna make sure we have the right model and we want to validate it because we will try several number of trees.
cues.zh: 先視覺化，確認模型正確，因為要試不同的樹數。

cues.en: Here we are starting with 10 trees so we wanna see if it looks like a correct model.
cues.zh: 目前十棵樹，先看看模型樣貌是否合理。

cues.en: So I'm going to execute this section.
cues.zh: 執行這一段。

cues.en: Here we go.
cues.zh: 出來了。

cues.en: And let's see what we'll get.
cues.zh: 看看結果。

cues.en: Okay, so first of all, this looks fine.
cues.zh: 首先，看起來沒問題。

cues.en: We don't seem to have any problem here.
cues.zh: 似乎沒有任何問題。

cues.en: The only thing that we can improve very quickly is actually those straight lines here that are supposed to be vertical.
cues.zh: 唯一能立刻改善的，是這些應該垂直的斜線。

cues.en: And to get a better representation of this, we just need to increase the resolution as we did for decision three regression.
cues.zh: 和決策樹迴歸一樣，提高解析度就能更準確呈現。

cues.en: So let's add 0.01.
cues.zh: 將步長設為 0.01。

cues.en: That will be sufficient and let's re-execute this.
cues.zh: 這樣就夠了，重新執行。

cues.en: And now much better.
cues.zh: 現在好多了。

cues.en: It almost looks like it's some vertical straight lines representing better than non-continuity.
cues.zh: 幾乎像垂直直線，更清楚表示不連續性。

cues.en: And so now what can we say?
cues.zh: 現在能說什麼？

cues.en: Let's zoom on this plot to have a better look.
cues.zh: 放大圖形，仔細看。

cues.en: And now let's interpret.
cues.zh: 現在解讀結果。

cues.en: Okay, so the answer to the enigma that I asked you in the previous section and that I was asking you again in this tutorial is that we simply get more steps
cues.zh: 上一節及這個教學留的問題，答案是：使用多棵決策樹，會比一棵樹產生更多

cues.en: in the stairs by having several decision trees instead of one decision tree.
cues.zh: 階梯。

cues.en: We have a lot more steps in the stairs than what we had was one decision tree.
cues.zh: 階數比單一決策樹多很多。

cues.en: And therefore we have a lot more splits of the whole range of levels and therefore a lot more intervals of the different levels.
cues.zh: 因此整個職等值域有更多切分，形成更多區間。

cues.en: So each straight horizontal line here separated by these vertical lines are one interval that is one split.
cues.zh: 每條被垂直線分隔的水平線，就代表一個區間或切分。

cues.en: And the fact that we get more steps in the stairs is actually quite intuitive because if we get, for example, this prediction here for the 6.5 level, well, what happened for this prediction
cues.zh: 階梯變多也很直覺。例如職等 6.5 的這個預測，

cues.en: is that we had 10 trees voting on which step the salary of the 6.5 level position would be.
cues.zh: 是十棵樹各自對職等 6.5 薪資應落在哪一階投票。

cues.en: And then the random forest took the average of all the different predictions of the salary of the 6.5 level made by all the different trees in the forest.
cues.zh: 接著森林對所有樹的職等 6.5 薪資預測取平均。

cues.en: And for example if we take the fourth position level, 10 votes were made.
cues.zh: 例如職等 4，也有十個投票。

cues.en: Each of these 10 votes correspond to one prediction of the level four salary made by each one of those 10 trees.
cues.zh: 每個投票，是十棵樹中某一棵對職等 4 薪資的預測。

cues.en: And then the random forest took the average of these 10 predictions.
cues.zh: 森林再對這十個預測取平均。

cues.en: And this average is nothing else than the prediction of the level four salary made by the random forest itself.
cues.zh: 這個平均就是隨機森林本身對職等 4 的薪資預測。

cues.en: And so we get more steps because simply the whole range of levels is split into more intervals.
cues.zh: 所以階梯更多，因為整個職等值域被切成更多區間。

cues.en: And that is because the random forest is calculating many different averages of its decision trees predictions in each of these intervals.
cues.zh: 每段裡，森林都計算不同的決策樹預測平均。

cues.en: So that's what happened.
cues.zh: 就是這麼回事。

cues.en: It's quite intuitive.
cues.zh: 很直覺。

cues.en: However, there is something important to point out here is that if we add a lot more trees in our random forest, well, it doesn't mean we'll get a lot more steps
cues.zh: 不過有件重要的事：如果再增加很多樹，不代表階梯一定會多出很多

cues.en: in the stairs.
cues.zh: 階。

cues.en: Because the more you add some trees, the more the average of the different predictions made by the trees is converging to the same average.
cues.zh: 因為樹越多，各樹預測的平均，越會收斂到同一個平均。

cues.en: This is based on the same technique, entropy and information gain.
cues.zh: 都基於相同的資訊熵與資訊增益技術。

cues.en: So the more you add trees, the more the average of these votes will converge to the same ultimate average.
cues.zh: 所以樹越多，投票平均會越收斂到相同的最終平均。

cues.en: And therefore it will converge to some certain shape of stairs here.
cues.zh: 因此會收斂成某種固定的階梯形狀。

cues.en: So that's important to visualize this as well.
cues.zh: 這個概念也值得視覺化理解。

cues.en: And now since we have our intuition of the visualization of the random forest regression in 1D, let's see what happens with the prediction.
cues.zh: 了解一維隨機森林圖形的直覺後，看看預測會如何。
